Confluence over 8 weeks bear vs bull
Four rungs, and you only act on the top one. STAND DOWN, nothing is on. WATCH, one or two signals are true but they stand alone. SETUP, several are lining up. ACT, three of them have held for three sessions and they come from three different families, so it is not the same idea counted three times. A signal only counts once it has held three sessions, because one day in the zone is noise. Signals our lab rejected are left out of the count.
The three counts: firing = the condition is true at today's close, confirmed = it has been true 3 sessions in a row (this is what the bar counts), building = not true yet but close.
How to read each row: every signal is a checklist. Most of them need several things to be true at the same moment, so each line shows the condition, where it stands now and what it needs. A signal fires only when every box is ticked, which is why a number can sit well past its own trigger while the row still reads BUILDING. Some signals have two paths, either one arms them. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = getting close, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back. High-yield spreads widening off the tights is the most direct credit-stress gauge on the board, and it flips before equity does more often than not. The z-score condition is in place and nothing is missing.

Our lab treats this as an observation rather than a stood-up signal, but the underlying FRED series is cleaner than the HYG price proxy, so weigh it heavier than a chart pattern. It gets killed if spreads compress back toward the lows, and it gets confirmed if HYG drawdown deepens alongside it.

Gold holding bid while HYG and TLT stay firm is the haven filter that separates real risk-off from vol pops that go nowhere, and it is the quality control for every bear signal next to it. The haven confirmed flag is in place and nothing is missing.

Our lab uses this specifically to kill the Spring-2021-style false positives without losing the real episodes like COVID, 2022 and August 2024, so when it is on, you trust the other bear signals more. It flips off if gold rolls over or credit and long duration start selling with equity.

Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise). In formation = consecutive sessions spent in the top quintile of the metric. Sources: Polygon cache, nightly signal history tables, Yahoo for index series, FRED for macro. Grey rows are conditions Kerberos tracked that we cannot source yet; they stay listed so the catalog remains complete. Our own backtest verdicts live inside each row's detail.
